pairs.fixture: Authenticate an ordinary user. Call POST /todos with the title omitted. Evaluate the response from that POST.
pairs.precise: Register a user and login to get an access token. Call POST /todos with an empty or missing title field. Verify that the response status code is 400 Bad Request and the response body contains a validation error indicating 'The Title field is required.'
pairs.vague: Creating a todo without a title returns a validation error

pairs.fixture: Authenticate an ordinary user and create an incomplete todo titled My Test Todo. Call GET using its ID. Evaluate the response from that GET.
pairs.precise: Register a user and login. Create a todo with title 'My Test Todo'. Use the returned todo ID to call GET /todos/{id}. Verify the response status is 200 OK, the returned todo has the same ID and title 'My Test Todo', and isComplete is false.
pairs.vague: Getting a specific todo by ID returns the correct todo

pairs.fixture: Authenticate an ordinary user and create a todo. DELETE it by ID, then retrieve it to verify removal. Evaluate only the response from DELETE.
pairs.precise: Register a user and login. Create a todo with title 'Todo to Delete' and note the ID. Call DELETE /todos/{id}. Verify the response status is 200 OK. Then call GET /todos/{id} and verify the response is 404 Not Found (todo no longer exists).
pairs.vague: Deleting a todo removes it from the database

pairs.fixture: Authenticate an ordinary user and create an incomplete todo. PUT with the same ID, title Updated Todo, and isComplete true, then retrieve it. Evaluate only the response from PUT.
pairs.precise: Register a user and login. Create a todo with title 'Original Todo'. The todo should have isComplete=false. Call PUT /todos/{id} with isComplete=true and title 'Updated Todo'. Verify response is 200 OK. Then call GET /todos/{id} and verify isComplete is now true and title is 'Updated Todo'.
pairs.vague: Updating a todo correctly changes its fields
